arguments.value: Presented with progressive low back pain and left leg radicular symptoms refractory to conservative treatment; MRI showed an L5-S1 epidural/paraspinal abscess. Surgical debridement grew Streptococcus gallolyticus, prompting malignancy workup that revealed sigmoid adenocarcinoma.
